changelog: FIX CRITICAL: _sbRestDeleteVale now throws on failure instead of silently returning — no more fake-success deletions.
FIX CRITICAL: _sbRestDeleteVale verifies the delete actually worked by re-reading Supabase, with up to 2 retries.
FIX CRITICAL: When gestorId is missing, _sbRestDeleteVale scans all rows to find the vale instead of giving up.
FIX CRITICAL: adminDeleteVale and cancelVale now use shared _doValeSupabaseDelete with 3 retries and exponential backoff.
FIX CRITICAL: If all retries fail, the deletion is re-enqueued so it gets retried when connection returns.
FIX CRITICAL: Gestor vales can now be deleted regardless of status (not just pending).
FIX: _doRestPoll now always updates localStorage from Supabase (even when empty) — no more zombie products.
FIX: _doRestPoll now logs sync errors for productos/categorias instead of silently swallowing them.
FIX: catalogo.html apiFetch now filters null data rows (prevents TypeError).
NEW: PDF generation includes product images with fallback for missing images.
NEW: catalogo.html PDF includes product images.
NEW: Gestor delete button shows 'Eliminar' (not 'Cancelar') for all vales.
